comment: Absolute legend.  Went too maybe 30% of the classes and got an A-.  I am probably one the most unartistic kids at the University.

this guy is crazy. started out assigning way too many assignments and then cancelled half of them because there wasnt enough time. couldnt handle a class full of 13 students and the mess that came with it. says you should spend a lot of time outside of class working, but to get a B doing the minimum is all thats necessary.
He is insane but still a pretty easy class

this class was ridiculous. i probably went to half the classes and am probably going to get an A...and im the most unartistic kid i know. if your works are decent and completed in a reasonable amount of time its impossible to get below a B. he is a really nice guy and if you get a bad grade you can talk to him and he'll most likely bump you up.

Definitely take his sculpture class if you are an unartistic student trying to get your art requirement done! As long as you try and your works are decent he'll give a B. Usually get out of class real early, don't have to come...such a chill class and chill prof

As a freshman in a class with mostly upper level art students, I felt comfortable yet challenged.  Mark helped with directing and guiding but still allowing me to make my own decisions with my peices.  A great instructor, especially if you need guidance on how to do art.  Great to fill a requirement because he grades based on his own directions!

Great Prof., even though he is teaching something outside of his expertise.  He really gets into the core books and helps his students to as well.  Class disucssions are great and he has taken us outside on really nice days, great atmosphere...really chill, awesome prof.
